$comment: THE declaration of omx-delay: every face (CLAP, LV2, the MOD GUI) and the parameter header are generated from this file by tools/gen.mjs and tools/modgui-gen.mjs. Parameter order is append-only. The travels are the OpenMixer console's delay travels.
name: omx delay
description: The OpenMixer console's stereo delay: one time, feedback through a tone filter, ping-pong and a wet/dry mix. The DSP is omx-dsp's <omxdsp/fx/omx_delay.h>, the console's own delay.
summary: Stereo delay up to 2 s: feedback through a tone filter that darkens each repeat, ping-pong, wet/dry mix. Zero latency, real-time safe, 44.1 to 192 kHz.
manual: | Time | 0 to 2000 ms, whole ms | 300 ms |
Plus the host's bypass. The tone filter holds the same corner at every sample rate, so a session
moved from 48 to 96 kHz sounds the same.
